# Time

> A local-first time report PWA built on @niclaslindstedt/oss-framework.
> Start working with one tap and stop with the same one; log breaks
> (lunch, coffee, a walk) and kinds of work (meetings, coding) as they happen
> or afterwards. One document, stored on-device as JSON, with an optional copy
> synced to the user's own Dropbox or Google Drive. Totals, balances and
> charts are derived from the logged spans at read time; nothing about a
> total is stored.

- App: https://time.niclaslindstedt.se/
- Source: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/time
- Framework: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/oss-framework

## Features

- Today: a running timer whose card's border fills clockwise with the day's
  share of its target and overshoots past it, a twelve-hour clock with time
  worked, breaks and kinds of work drawn on it,
  and one-tap buttons to start, stop, take a break or switch what you are
  working on
- Correcting a time without leaving Today: a break is booked for the length
  its kind usually takes and its end is printed on the clock's rim, tapping
  the clock opens the day stretch by stretch with each end movable, and
  tapping the timer corrects when you started
- Log: every day as a list of sessions, breaks and activities, each editable
  or deletable, with breaks and time worked addable after the fact
- Report: hours worked against target per day for a week or a month, where
  the hours went by kind of work, break time by kind, and the running balance
- Projects: one or several, each with its own working days, day length,
  break types with default lengths, and kinds of work; the project switcher
  only appears once there are two
- Settings: light/dark theme, the clock's look, numerals (sans, serif, mono
  or Roman) and size, week start, cloud sync, JSON backup and restore
- No account, no server, no analytics; installable and fully offline
